finding_candidates.statement: CKgP (and likewise full rational Chow generation) need not ascend along the finite etale S_n-ordering cover of an unordered incidence stack; transfer/pullback controls only the invariant summand, leaving nontrivial isotypics unchecked.

For (g,n)=(3,12) with d=18, the open input is W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}, dual to W_{20}H^{20}(18); expected types are BM Q(8) and untwisted ordinary Q(-10) at Chow codimension 10. Ordinary H^{16} of the open stack is not the inductive input.
Published CKgP/tautological-Chow coverage in genus 3 stops at n≤11 (c(3)=11); any n=12 argument requires new geometric input beyond THM-0005.

Failure of a CKgP-extension route leaves the pure-Tate claim for W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{3,12}) unproved but does not by itself produce a non-Tate summand; conversely, a pure-Tate proof would not automatically yield CKgP or tautological generation.

The packet and attempt supply neither an equivariant CKgP stratification of the ordered twelve-point cubic incidence locus nor a computation showing vanishing of non-invariant contributions in the target weight/degree.
